text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "RelatedPostId semantically references posts (its name and the postLinks schema point to posts.Id), while comments.Id is a comment identifier, and the 0.838 containment is fully explained by chance: comments.Id densely covers ~0.8 of the integer range spanned by RelatedPostId (1–115k), with only 2.5% coverage of the target."}
